Freelance and contract builds for companies that want work moved by agents, not a chatbot bolted on. I scope the workflow, build the system on your stack, and hand it over with the evals and runbooks your team needs to own it.

What I build

5

  1. Multi-agent workflow automationRouter → executor patterns with specialised agents and fallbacks, moving work across Slack, email, CRMs, calendars and internal APIs.
  2. RAG pipelinesRetrieval with ranking, freshness and source attribution, on pgvector or OpenSearch, with token-cost discipline built in.
  3. MCP and tool integrationsTool registries with JSON-schema validation, scoped OAuth, retry policy and side-effect logging.
  4. Human approval surfacesConfidence-gated handoff, reversible operations and an approval inbox, so nothing irreversible runs unreviewed.
  5. Durable executionCrash-resumable runs on PostgreSQL: checkpoints, retries, rollback and an explicit failure taxonomy per stage.

How a build runs

4

  1. 1. Scoping callYour workflow, your stack, the success metric and what must stay with a human.
  2. 2. Proof of conceptOne workflow working on your data, so you judge it on results, not slides.
  3. 3. Production hardeningEvals, regression gates, tracing and approval gates before wider rollout.
  4. 4. HandoverCode in your repo, the eval suite, runbooks and a walkthrough for your team.
